answer_1.quote: In this work, we perform the first comprehensive analysis of the effects that grounding objectives have on LVLM object hallucination in open (i.e., free-form) image captioning

answer_2.quote: We focus on two popular metrics for quantifying hallucination in open caption generation: CHAIR and FaithScore

answer_3.quote: FaithScore computation is a 2-stage process that relies: (1) on an LLM to extract 'atomic facts' from the generated text, phrasing them as statements (e.g., "There is a man")
